name: restfull-booker-newman
description: Newman runner for Restful Booker Postman collection

scripts.test:api: newman run "postman/collections/Restful Booker - Full CRUD + Auth.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/RestfulBooker - DEV.postman_environment.json" -r cli
scripts.report: newman run "postman/collections/Restful Booker - Full CRUD + Auth.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/RestfulBooker - DEV.postman_environment.json" --bail --timeout-request 15000 --delay-request 100 -r cli,json,junit,htmlextra --reporter-json-export "newman/reports/newman-report.json" --reporter-junit-export "newman/reports/newman-junit.xml" --reporter-htmlextra-export "newman/reports/newman-report.html"
scripts.report:ci: newman run "postman/collections/Restful Booker - Full CRUD + Auth.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/RestfulBooker - DEV.postman_environment.json" --timeout-request 20000 -r cli,junit --reporter-junit-export "newman/reports/newman-junit.xml"
